doc.description:
`filter`: send `id` (a saved Filter) or all of `field`, `operator`, `value` (test before save). `id` wins when both are sent.

`sleeve` with `role`: a dry run of one role. Roles come from `entry` / `exit` in the body, else from the Sleeve `id`. The `exit` role runs on top of entry (entry AND exit). Does not flip `tested`.

`sleeve` without `role`: the full Test of the Sleeve `id` (required). Uses the stored roles, Rank and order, and sets `tested` to `passed`.
